COMPANY : Leading Apparel Manufacturing – Activewear & Athleisure

POSITION : Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

LOCATION: Dhaka, Bangladesh

SALARY. : Open

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and results-driven Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead and overathleisure manufacturing industry, with a proven track record of managing large-scale manufacturing operations, driving business growth, improving operational efficiency, and building strong relationships with international customers and brands.

Key Responsibilities

Lead and manage the company's overall business operations, ensuring operational excellence and sustainable growth.
Oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations, including production planning, merchandising, sourcing, quality, supply chain, and factory management.
Develop and execute business strategies to achieve organizationaloperational excellence and sustainable growth.
Oversee end-to-end manufacturing operations, including production planning, merchandising, sourcing, quality, supply chain, and factory management.
Develop and execute business strategies to achieve organizational objectives and financial targets.
Drive manufacturing efficiency, productivity, cost optimization, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure high standards of product quality, compliance, and timely delivery.
Build and maintain relationships with international activewear and athleisure brands and customers.
Lead senior management teams and develop a high-performance organizational culture.
Identify new business opportunities, expand the customer portfolio, and strengthen market positioning.
Monitor operational and financial performance through KPIs and implement corrective actions where required.
Ensure effective utilization of resources, manufacturing capacity, and production facilities.
Required Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Textile Engineering, Industrial Engineering, or a relevant discipline.
20+ years of overall experience in the apparel manufacturing industry.
Previous experience as a CEO, COO, or equivalent senior leadership position in an apparel manufacturing organization.
Strong hands-on experience in activewear and athleisure manufacturing is mandatory.
Proven expertise in managing large-scale manufacturing and factory operations.
Strong understanding of performance wear, technical fabrics, knitwear, and garment manufacturing processes.
Experience working with international activewear and athleisure brands such as Nike, Adidas, Puma, Reebok, Under Armour, Lululemon, or Uniqlo will be highly preferred.
Strong knowledge of production management, operational excellence, supply chain, merchandising, and quality management.
Demonstrated ability to lead business transformation, improve profitability, and drive organizational growth.
Key Competencies

Strategic and operational leadership.
Strong business and financial acumen.
Manufacturing and production management.
Customer relationship and stakeholder management.
Decision-making and problem-solving.
Team leadership and organizational development.
Cost optimization and operational efficiency.
Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate will be a senior apparel manufacturing professional who has previously led operations at the CEO/COO level, with substantial exposure to activewear and athleisure manufacturing. The candidate must possess the ability to independently manage overall business operations, drive manufacturing performance, and lead the organization toward long-term growth and profitability.
